_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : السُّيوفُ مَفاتِيحُ الجَنّةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Swords are the keys to Paradise.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : المُجاهِدونَ تُفْتَحُ لَهُم أبْوابُ السَّماءِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The doors of the heavens are opened for those who wage jihad.

_source.chapter: Aiding Those Who Wage Jihad and Censure of Those Who Harm Them
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن جَهّزَ غازيا بسِلْكٍ أو إبْرَةٍ غَفَرَ اللّهُ لَهُ ما تَقدَّمَ من ذَنبهِ وما تَأخّرَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever equips a warrior, even with a needle and thread, Allah forgives his past and future sins.

_source.chapter: Aiding Those Who Wage Jihad and Censure of Those Who Harm Them
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن بَلّغَ رسالةَ غازٍ كانَ كَمَنْ أعْتقَ رَقَبةً، وهُو شَريكُهُ في بابِ «ثوابِ» غَزْوَتِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever carries a message on behalf of a fighter during war is like one who frees a slave, and he partakes in the reward of the one who actually fought.

_source.chapter: Aiding Those Who Wage Jihad and Censure of Those Who Harm Them
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : اتَّقوا أذَى المُجاهِدينَ في سبيلِ اللّهِ ، فإنَّ اللّهَ يَغْضَبُ لَهُم كَما يَغْضَبُ للرُّسُلِ ، ويَسْتَجيبُ لَهُم كَما يَسْتَجيبُ لَهُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Be wary of harming those who fight in the way of Allah, for Allah is angered for their sake just as He is for the sake of the Prophet (SAWA), and He answers their prayers just as He answers the prayers of the Prophet (SAWA).

_source.chapter: The Command To Wage Jihad With Ones Hands, Tongue, and Heart
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : صَلاةُ الرّجُلِ مُتَقَلِّداً بسَيفِهِ تَفْضُلُ على صَلاتِهِ غَيرَ مُتَقَلِّدٍ بسَبعِمائةِ ضِعْفٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The prayer of one carrying his sword is seven hundred times better than praying without it.

_source.chapter: The Command To Wage Jihad With Ones Hands, Tongue, and Heart
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : جاهِدوا في سبيلِ اللّهِ بأيْديكُم، فإنْ لَم تَقْدِروا فجاهِدوا بألسِنَتِكُم ، فإنْ لَم تَقْدِروا فجاهِدوا بقُلوبِكُم .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Fight in the way of Allah with your hands; and if you are not able to do so then fight with your tongues; and if you are still not able to then fight with your hearts.

_source.chapter: The Command To Wage Jihad With Ones Hands, Tongue, and Heart
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اللّهَ اللّهَ في الجِهادِ بأمْوالِكُم وأنْفُسِكُم وألْسِنَتِكُم في سبيلِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘By Allah! By Allah! Wage jihad with your wealth, your selves and your tongues for the sake of Allah.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : فمَن تَركَ الجِهادَ ألْبسَهُ اللّهُ ذُلاًّ في نفسِهِ، وفَقْرا في مَعيشَتِهِ، ومَحْقا في دِينهِ. إنَّ اللّهَ تباركَ وتعالى أعَزَّ اُمّتي بسَنابِكِ خَيْلِها ومَراكِزِ رِماحِها .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah covers with disgrace the one who abandons jihad, and subjects him to poverty, and deprivation in his religion. Verily Allah, blessed and most High, has honoured my community by the solid hooves of its cavalry, and the tips of its lances.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الجِهادِ على أرْبَعِ شُعَبٍ : على الأمرِ بالمَعروفِ والنَّهيِ عنِ المُنكَرِ والصِّدْقِ في المَواطِنِ وشَنَآنِ الفاسقِينَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Jihad has four branches: enjoining the good, forbidding the wrong, fortitude in the battlefield, and detesting the wicked.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : رِباطُ يَومٍ في سبيلِ اللّهِ خَيرٌ مِن الدُّنيا وما عَلَيها.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Keeping your posts for a single day is better than the whole world and all that it contains.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : كُلُّ عَملٍ مُنْقَطِعٌ عَن صاحبِهِ إذا ماتَ إلّا المُرابِطَ في سبيلِ اللّهِ ، فإنَّهُ يُنْمى لَهُ عَملُهُ ويُجْرى علَيهِ رِزْقُهُ إلى يَومِ القِيامَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Every action will be separated from its owner upon death, except the one who maintained his post for the sake of Allah, since it will be increased and rewarded to him until the Day of Resurrection.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : حَرَسُ لَيلةٍ في سبيلِ اللّهِ عزّ وجلّ أفْضَلُ مِن ألفِ لَيلةٍ يُقامُ لَيلُها ويُصامُ نَهارُها .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Standing guard for a single night for the sake of Allah is better than a thousand nights spent in worship followed by fasting during the day.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : عَيْنانِ لا تَمَسُّهُما النّارُ : عَينٌ بَكَتْ مِن خَشْيَةِ اللّهِ ، وعَينٌ باتَتْ تَحْرُسُ في سبيلِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The eyes of two categories of people will never touch the fire: the one who cried out of fear of Allah, and the one who spent the night awake standing guard for the sake of Allah.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اعلَموا أنّهُ لَيس مِن شيءٍ إلّا ويَكادُ صاحِبُهُ يَشبَعُ مِنهُ ويَمَلُّه إلّا الحياةَ ؛ فإنّهُ لا يَجِدُ في المَوتِ راحةً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Know that man gets satiated and wearied with everything except life, because he does not find any comfort in death.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : طَعْمُ الماءِ الحياةُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The flavour of water is life.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ العسكريُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : خَيرٌ مِن الحياةِ ما إذا فَقَدْتَهُ أبْغَضْتَ الحياةَ ، وشَرٌّ مِن المَوتِ ما إذا نَزَلَ بِكَ أحْبَبتَ المَوتَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Askari (AS) said, ‘Better than life is that thing which if you lose it you become disgusted with life, and worse than death is that thing which if it comes to you makes you love death.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا حياةَ إلّا بالدِّينِ ، ولا مَوتَ إلّا بجُحودِ اليَقينِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There is no life except through religion, and there is no death except through denial of the certain truth.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : التّوحيدُ حياةُ النّفْسِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Monotheism is the life of the soul.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ عُمرَكَ عَدَدُ أنفاسِكَ ، وعَلَيها رَقيبٌ يُحصيها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily your lifespan is the total number of your breaths, and there is a watcher over them counting them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّهُ لَن يَستَقبِلَ أحَدُكُم يَوما مِن عُمرِهِ إلّا بِفِراقِ آخَرَ مِن أجَلِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily nobody will receive a single extra day to his lifespan except that another day will be taken from him from his end.

_source.chapter: Making the Most of Ones Life
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كُنْ عَلى عُمرِكَ أشَحَّ مِنكَ عَلى دِرهَمِكَ ودينارِكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Be even more niggardly with your life than with your dirham and your dinar [i.e. your money].

_source.chapter: Making the Most of Ones Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ العُمرَ مَحدودٌ لَن يَتَجاوَزَ أحَدٌ ماقُدِّرَ لَهُ، فبادِروا قَبلَ نَفاذِ الأجَلِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily lifespan is fixed and no one will surpass that which has been allotted to him, so rush to make the most of it before time runs out.

_source.chapter: Making the Most of Ones Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ماضي يَومِكَ فائتٌ ، وآتيهِ مُتَّهَمٌ ، ووَقتُكَ مُغتَنَمٌ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Your yesterday has passed on, your tomorrow is uncertain, and your today is to be taken advantage of.

_source.chapter: Making the Most of Ones Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما أسرَعَ السّاعاتِ فِي اليَومِ ، وأسرَعَ الأيّامَ فِي الشَّهرِ ، وأسرَعَ الشُّهورَ فِي السَّنَةِ ، وأسرَعَ السّنينَ (السَّنَةَ) فِي العُمرِ!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘How fast the hours in a day go by, and how fast the days in a month, and how fast the months in a year, and how fast the years in a lifetime!

_source.chapter: Making the Most of Ones Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أيُّها النّاسُ! الآنَ الآنَ مِن قَبلِ النَّدَمِ ، ومِن قَبلِ «أن تَقولَ نَفسٌ يا حَسرَتى عَلى ما فَرَّطتُ في جَنبِ اللّهِ».
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O people! [take advantage of] Now! Now before regret sets in, and before “anyone should say, ‘Alas for my negligence in the vicinage of Allah!” [Qur an 39:56].

_source.chapter: Making the Most of Ones Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رَحِمَ اللّهُ امرَأً عَلِمَ أنَّ نَفَسَهُ خُطاهُ إلى أجَلِهِ ، فبادَرَ عَمَلَهُ وقَصَّرَ أمَلَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah has mercy on the man who knows that his breaths are but his steps towards his end, so he hastens to perform good deeds and cuts short his high hopes.

_source.chapter: Making the Most of Ones Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِحذَروا ضَياعَ الأعمارِ فيما لا يَبقى لَكُم ، فَفائتُها لا يَعودُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Be cautious of wasting away your lives in that which will not last for you, for whatever has passed of them never returns.

_source.chapter: Making the Most of Ones Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ عُمرَكَ مَهرُ سَعادَتِكَ إن أنفَدتَهُ في طاعَةِ رَبِّكَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily your lifetime is the ransom for your eternal prosperity if you spend it in the obedience of your Lord.

_source.chapter: He Whose Life Will Be a Proof Against Him
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذَا كانَ يَومُ القِيامَةِ نودِيَ: أينَ أبناءُ السِّتّينَ ؟ وهُوَ العُمرُ الّذي قالَ اللّهُ تَعالى: «أوَ لَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم ما يَتَذَكَّرُ فيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ».
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘On the Day of Resurrection, it will be announced, ‘Where are the sixty year olds for this is the age referring to which Allah, most High, has said, “Did we not give you a life long enough that one who is heedful might take admonition”

_source.chapter: He Whose Life Will Be a Proof Against Him
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العُمرُ الّذي أعذَرَ اللّهُ فيهِ إلَى ابنِ آدَمَ سِتّونَ سَنَةً .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The age up to which Allah accepts the excuse of His servants for certain things is sixty years.

_source.chapter: He Whose Life Will Be a Proof Against Him
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فيالَها حَسرَةً عَلى كُلِّ ذي غَفلَةٍ أن يَكونَ عُمُرُهُ عَلَيهِ حُجَّةً ، وأن تُؤَدِّيَهُ أيّامُهُ إلَى الشِّقوَةِ !
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘So alas for every negligent one that his age be a proof against him, and that the days of his life should lead him to perdition!

_source.chapter: He Whose Life Will Be a Proof Against Him
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا أتَت عَلَى العَبدِ أربَعونَ سَنَةً قيلَ لَهُ: خُذْ حِذرَكَ ؛ فإنَّكَ غَيرُ مَعذورٍ ، ولَيسَ ابنُ أربَعينَ سَنَةً أحَقَّ بِالعُذرِ مِنِ ابنِ عِشرينَ سَنَةً.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘When a man reaches forty years of age, it is said to him, ‘Be on your guard, for now you have no excuse, and the forty-year old man is no longer as worthy of being excused as the twenty-year old man.

_source.chapter: That Which Leads to an Increase in Lifespan
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أكثِرْ مِنَ الطَّهورِ يَزِدِ اللّهُ في عُمرِكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Remain mostly in the state of purity and Allah will increase your lifespan.

_source.chapter: That Which Leads to an Increase in Lifespan
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن سَرَّهُ أن يُبسَطَ لَهُ في رِزقِهِ ويُنسَأَ لَهُ في أجَلِهِ فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever would like his sustenance to be amplified and his destined end to be postponed should maintain relations with his kin.

_source.chapter: That Which Leads to an Increase in Lifespan
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أرادَ البَقاءَ ـ ولا بَقاءَ ـ فَلْيُباكِرِ الغَداءَ ، وَليُجَوِّدِ الحِذاءَ ، وَليُخَفِّفِ الرِّداءَ ، وَلْيُقِلَّ غُشْيانَ النِّساءِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who wishes to remain alive - though there is no remaining forever - should eat his lunch early, wear good shoes, dress in light clothing, and lessen his sexual intercourse with women.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 38, number:112

_source.chapter: That Which Leads to an Increase in Lifespan
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مُروا شيعَتَنا بِزِيارَةِ قَبرِ الحُسَينِ بنِ عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ؛ فإنَّ إتيانَهُ يَزيدُ فِي الرِّزقِ ، ويَمُدُّ فِي العُمرِ ، ويَدفَعُ مَدافِعَ السُّوءِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Command our shiaa to visit the grave of al-Husayn b. Ali (AS), for verily going there increases sustenance, extends ones life, and repels evil forces.

_source.chapter: That Which Leads to an Increase in Lifespan
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن حَسُنَت نِيَّتُهُ زِيدَ في عُمرِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who has good intentions is given an increase in lifespan.

_source.chapter: That Which Leads to an Increase in Lifespan
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن حَسُنَ بِرُّهُ بِأهلِ بَيتِهِ زِيدَ في عُمرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who excels in his good treatment of his family is given an increase in his lifespan.

_source.chapter: That Which Leads to an Increase in Lifespan
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إن أحبَبتَ أن يَزيدَ اللّهُ في عُمرِكَ فسُرَّ أبَوَيكَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If you would like Allah to increase your lifespan then please your parents.
_source.cited_from: Al-Zuhd li al-Husayn b. Saaid, p. 33, number:87

_source.chapter: The Believer and Asking for a Long Life
_source.arabic: فاطمةُ الزَّهراءُ (عَلَيهَا الّسَلامُ) ـ فِي المُناجاةِ ـ: اللّهُمَّ بِعِلمِكَ الغَيبَ ، وقُدرَتِكَ عَلَى الخَلقِ ، أحيِني ما عَلِمتَ الحَياةَ خَيراً لي، وتَوَفَّني إذا كانَتِ الوَفاةُ خَيراً لي.
_source.english: Fatima al-Zahra (AS) said in her intimate supplication, ‘O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen, and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know that life is good for me, and cause me to die when death is good for me.

_source.chapter: The Believer and Asking for a Long Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِن دُعائهِ في مَكارِمِ الأخلاقِ ـ: وعَمِّرْني ما كانَ عُمري بِذْلَةً في طاعَتِكَ ، فإذا كانَ عُمري مَرتَعاً لِلشَّيطانِ فَاقبِضْني إلَيكَ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said in his supplication for noble moral traits, ‘And let me live so long as my life is spent in Your obedience, but when my life becomes a breeding ground for Satan, then take me to You.

_source.chapter: The Wisdom Behind Mans Ignorance of the Span of His Life
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَأمَّلِ الآنَ يا مُفَضَّلُ ما سُتِرَ عَنِ الإنسانِ عِلمُهُ مِن مُدَّةِ حَياتِهِ ؛ فإنَّهُ لَو عَرَفَ مِقدارَ عُمرِهِ وكانَ قَصيرَ العُمرِ لَم يَتَهنَّأْ بِالعَيشِ مَعَ تَرَقُّبِ المَوتِ وتَوَقُّعِهِ لِوَقتٍ قَد عَرَفَهُ ، بَل كانَ يَكونُ بِمَنزِلَةِ مَن قَد فَنى مالُهُ أو قارَبَ الفَناءَ ، فقَدِ استَشعَرَ الفَقرَ والوَجَلَ مِن فَناءِ مالِهِ وخَوفِ الفَقرِ ، عَلى أنَّ الّذي يَدخُلُ عَلَى الإنسانِ مِن فَناءِ العُمرِ أعظَمُ مِمّا يَدخُلُ عَلَيهِ مِن فَناءِ المالِ ، لأِنَّ مَن يَقِلُّ مالُه يَأمَلُ أن يَستَخلِفَ مِنهُ فيَسكُنُ إلى ذلكَ ، ومَن أيقَنَ بِفَناءِ العُمرِ استَحكَمَ عَلَيهِ اليَأسُ ، وإن كانَ طَويلَ العُمرِ ثُمَّ عَرَفَ ذلكَ وَثِقَ بِالبَقاءِ ، وَانهَمَكَ فِي اللَّذّاتِ والمَعاصي ، وعَمِلَ عَلى أنَّهُ يَبلُغُ مِن ذلكَ شَهوَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَتوبُ في آخِرِ عُمرِهِ ... فإن قُلتَ: وها هُوَ الآنَ قَد سُتِرَ عَنهُ مِقدارُ حَياتِه وصارَ يَتَرَقَّبُ المَوتَ ، في كُلِّ ساعَةٍ يُقارِفُ الفَواحِشَ ويَنتَهِكُ المَحارِمَ ! قُلنا: إنَّ وَجهَ التَّدبيرِ في هذا البابِ هُوَ الّذي جَرى عَلَيهِ الأمرُ فيهِ ، فإن كانَ الإنسانُ مَعَ ذلكَ لا يَرعَوي ولا يَنصَرِفُ عَنِ المَساوئِ فإنَّما ذلكَ مِن مَرَحِهِ ومِن قَساوَةِ قَلبِهِ ، لا مِن خَطَأٍ فِي التَّدبيرِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Contemplate now O Mufadhal about the fact that man s lifespan has been kept concealed from his knowledge; for verily if he was to know the span of his life, and if it were short, he would never take pleasure in living, knowing his approaching death and always in anticipation of the time that he knows. In fact, he would be like someone whose wealth has perished or is close to perishing, so he feels a sense of poverty and terror at the thought of losing his wealth and a fear of poverty, even though that feeling which the man who knows that he is going to lose his life is much more intense, for the one whose wealth is diminishing still continues to hope that some of it will remain enabling him to live off that, whereas he who is certain of the loss of his life is taken over by despair. And if instead his lifespan was to be long, and he knew this, he would be certain of staying alive and would therefore become absorbed in vain pleasures and sins, and would act to gratify his desires intending to repent at the end of his life… And if you retort by saying that right now, even though his lifespan is concealed from him and he is approaching death, he still yields to vile sins and commits forbidden acts, we would reply that the way this matter has been decreed is exactly how it is at the moment, and if man, in spite of that [i.e. his ignorance of his death] does not desist from and shun sins then that is because of his own heedless merriment and the hardness of his heart, and not because of a mistake in divine planning!

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أهنَى العَيشِ اطّراحُ الكُلَفِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most wholesome lifestyle is achieved through throwing out unnecessary expenses.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أطيَبُ العَيشِ القَناعَةُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most pleasant [type] of life is [a life of] contentment.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أنعَمُ النّاسِ عَيشا مَن مَنَحَهُ اللّهُ سُبحانَهُ القَناعَةَ، وأصلَحَ لَهُ زَوجَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The man with the most comfortable lifestyle is he whom Allah, Glory be to Him, has granted contentment and to whom he has given a virtuous wife.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا عَيشَ أهنَأُ مِن حُسنِ الخُلقِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There is no lifestyle more wholesome than [living] good-naturedly.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثَلاثَةٌ تُكَدِّرُ العَيشَ: السُّلطانُ الجائرُ، والجارُ السَّوءُ، والمَرأةُ البَذِيَّةُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Three things spoil ones lifestyle an oppressive ruler, a bad neighbour, and a loathsome wife.

_source.arabic: الخصال الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خَمسُ خِصالٍ مَن فَقَدَ واحِدَةً مِنهُنَّ لَم يَزَلْ ناقِصَ العَيشِ زائلَ العَقلِ مَشغولَ القَلبِ، فأوَّلُها: صِحَّةُ البَدَنِ، والثّانِيَةُ: الأمنُ، والثّالِثَةُ: السَّعَةُ في الرِّزقِ، والرّابِعَةُ: الأنيسُ المُوافِقُ ـ [ قال الراوي :] قُلتُ: وما الأنيسُ المُوافِقُ ؟ قالَ: الزَّوجَةُ الصّالِحَةُ، والوَلَدُ الصّالِحُ، والخَليطُ الصّالِحُ ـ والخامِسَةُ: وهِيَ تَجمَعُ هذِه الخِصالَ: الدَّعَةُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There are five things which if one where to lose just one of them it would render his life incomplete, his intellect short-lived, and his heart preoccupied. The first of these is health of the body; the second is security; the third is ample sustenance; the fourth is a compatible companion. [The narrator says], ‘I asked, ‘What is a compatible companion to which he replied, ‘The virtuous wife, the virtuous son and the virtuous friend. And the fifth one, which sums up these four things, is mild-temperedness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا لَم تَكُن عالِماً ناطِقاً فَكُن مُستَمِعاً واعِيَاً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Even if you are not an articulate scholar, at least be an attentive listener.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ألا إنَّ أسمَعَ الأسماعِ ما وَعى التَّذكيرَ وقَبِلَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Indeed the most heedful of all ears is that which is attentive to and accepting of a reminder.

_source.chapter: Those Whose Ears Have Been Sealed
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما كُلُّ ذِي قَلبٍ بِلَبِيبٍ ، ولا كُلُّ ذِي سَمعٍ بِسَمِيعٍ ، ولا كُلُّ ناظِرٍ بِبَصيرٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Not every man with a heart is understanding, nor every man with an ear a listener, and nor every man with eyes able to see.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَوِّدْ اُذُنَكَ حُسنَ الاستِماعِ، ولا تُصغِ إلى ما لا يَزِيدُ في صَلاحِكَ استِماعُهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Accustom your ear to listen effectively, and do not listen to anything that will not benefit your progress.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سامِعُ ذِكرِ اللّهِ ذاكِرٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The one who listens to the remembrance of Allah in turn remembers [Him].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أحسَنَ الاستِماعَ تَعَجَّلَ الانتِفاعَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever listens effectively reaps its benefits immediately.

_source.chapter: The Obligation Incumbent On the Hearing
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فَفَرَضَ على السَّمعِ أن لا تُصغِيَ بهِ إلى المَعاصِي ، فقالَ عَزَّ وجلَّ: «وَقَدْ نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُم فِي الكِتابِ أنْ إذا سَمِعْتُم آياتِ اللّهِ يُكْفَرُ بِها وَيُسْتَهزأُ بِها فَلا تَقْعُدُوا مَعَهُم حَتَّى يَخُوضُوا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيرِهِ إنَّكُم إذا مِثْلُهُم إنَّ اللّهَ جامِعُ المُنافِقِينَ والكافِرِينَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ جَمِيعاً».
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The obligation incumbent upon the hearing is that it not be used for acts of disobedience, for Allah, Mighty and Exalted, has said, "Certainly He has sent down to you in the Book that when you hear Allah's signs being disbelieved and derided, do not sit with them until they engage in some other discourse, or else you [too] will be like them" [Quran 4:140].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : الخاسِرُ مَن غَفَلَ عَن إصْلاحِ المَعَادِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The loser is the one who is negligent of reforming his Hereafter.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : المُنْفِقُ عُمرَهُ في طَلَبِ الدُّنيا خاسِرُ الصَّفْقَةِ ، عادِمُ التَّوفيقِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The one who spends his life seeking out this world has attained a poor deal and has lost divine succour.

_source.chapter: To Become a Loser in the World and the Hereafter
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سُئلَ : مَنِ العَظيمُ الشَّقاءِ ؟ ـ : رجُلٌ تَرَكَ الدُّنيا للدُّنيا فَفاتَتْهُ الدُّنيا وخَسِرَ الآخِرَةَ ، ورَجُلٌ تَعَبّدَ واجْتَهَدَ وصامَ رِئاءَ النّاسِ فذلكَ الّذي حُرِمَ لذّاتَ الدُّنيا ولَحِقَهُ التَّعَبُ الّذي لَو كانَ بهِ مُخْلِصا لاسْتَحَقَّ ثوابَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) when asked about who has the greatest misfortune, said, ‘A man who abandons the world for the sake of the world, and therefore he misses out on the world and loses the Hereafter, and a man who worships, struggles and fasts as a display for others, and thus forbids [himself] the pleasures of this world and also tires himself. And were he to do all that sincerely [for the sake of Allah], he would be deserving of its reward.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّ أخْسَرَ النّاسِ صَفْقَةً وأخْيَبَهُم سَعْياً: رجُلٌ أخْلَقَ بَدنَهُ في طَلبِ مالِهِ ولَم تُساعِدْهُ المَقاديرُ على إرادَتِهِ ، فخَرجَ مِن الدُّنيا بحَسْرَتِهِ ، وقَدِمَ على الآخِرَةِ بتَبِعَتِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the biggest loser with the worst end of the deal and the most unsuccessful in his striving is the man who exerts himself in the quest for his wealth even though fate does not help him in his aims, and he consequently leaves this world with regret while heading towards the Hereafter, where he will face its ill consequences.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المَودَّةُ قَرابَةٌ مُسْتَفادَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Love is acquired kinship.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): القَرابَةُ إلى المَودَّةِ أحْوَجُ مِن المَودَّةِ إلى القَرابَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Love does not need kinship so much as kinship needs love.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثلاثٌ يُوجِبْنَ المَحبَّةَ: حُسنُ الخُلقِ ، وحُسنُ الرِّفقِ ، والتَّواضُعُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Three things bring about love: good temperament, kindness, and humbleness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثلاثةٌ تُورِثُ المَحبَّةَ: الدِّينُ ، والتَّواضُعُ، والبَذْلُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Three things bring about love: piety, humbleness, and generosity.

_source.chapter: Those Who Must Not Be Endeared
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أسْرَعُ المَوَدّاتِ انْقِطاعاً مَوَدّاتُ الأشْرارِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The friendships that are the quickest to break are the friendships made with evildoers.

_source.chapter: Those Who Must Not Be Endeared
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إيّاكَ أنْ تُحِبَّ أعْداءَ اللّهِ، أو تُصْفِيَ وُدَّكَ لغَيرِ أولياءِ اللّهِ ، فإنّ مَن أحَبَّ قَوماً حُشِرَ مَعهُم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of loving the enemies of Allah, or of harbouring affection for other than the friends of Allah, for verily man will be resurrected with those whom he loves.

_source.chapter: The Blindness of Love [from Perceiving the Truth]
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): حُبُّكَ للشَّيْء يُعْمي و يُصِمُّ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Your love for a particular thing makes you blind and deaf.

_source.chapter: The Blindness of Love [from Perceiving the Truth]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَينُ المُحِبّ عَمِيَةٌ عن مَعايِبِ المَحبوبِ، واُذُنُه صَمّاءُ عَن قُبْحِ مَساوِيهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The lovers eye is blind to the defects of the beloved, and his ear is deaf to the ugliness of his misdeeds.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أحَبَّكَ نَهاكَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who loves you forbids you [from committing sin].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أحَبَّ شيئاً لَهِجَ بذِكْرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who loves something constantly mentions it.

_source.chapter: The Believers Intense Love for Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في الدعاء المنسوب إليه ـ: أنتَ الّذي أزَلْتَ الأغْيارَ عن قُلوبِ أحِبّائكَ حتّى لَم يُحِبّوا سِواكَ... ماذا وَجَدَ مَن فَقَدَكَ؟! وما الّذي فَقَد مَن وَجَدكَ؟! لَقد خابَ مَن رَضِيَ دُونَكَ بَدَلاً.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said in one of his supplications, ‘It is You Who removed the strangers from the hearts of Your lovers so that they never love other than You… What does the one who loses You find [besides You]?! And what does the one who finds You lose [out on]?! He indeed fails who is satisfied with a substitute for You.

_source.chapter: The Believers Intense Love for Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَمْحضُ رجُلٌ الإيمانَ باللّهِ حتّى يكونَ اللّهُ أحَبَّ إلَيهِ مِن نَفْسِهِ وأبيهِ واُمِّهِ ووُلْدِهِ وأهْلِهِ ومالِهِ ومِن النّاسِ كُلِّهِم.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Mans faith in Allah will not be pure until Allah becomes more beloved to him than his own self, his father, his mother, his children, his wife, his wealth, and all people.

_source.chapter: The Believers Intense Love for Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): القلبُ حَرَمُ اللّهِ ، فلا تُسْكِنْ حَرَمَ اللّهِ غَيرَ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The heart is the sanctuary of Allah, so do not lodge other than Allah in Allahs sanctuary.

_source.chapter: The Believers Intense Love for Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الحُبُّ أفْضَلُ مِن الخَوفِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Love [of Allah] is better than fear [of Him].

_source.chapter: That which Brings About the Love of Allah
_source.arabic: في حديثِ المِعراجِ: يا محمّدُ ، وَجَبتْ مَحَبَّتي للمُتَحابِّينَ فِيَّ ، ووَجَبتْ مَحَبَّتي للمُتَعاطِفينَ فِيَّ ، ووَجَبتْ مَحَبَّتي للمُتَواصِلينَ فِيَّ، ووَجَبتْ مَحَبَّتي للمُتَوكِّلينَ عَلَيَّ ، ولَيس لمَحَبَّتي عَلَمٌ ولا غايَةٌ ولا نِهايَةٌ ، وكُلَّما رَفَعْتُ لَهُم عَلَماً وَضَعْتُ لَهُم عَلَماً .
_source.english: It is related in the tradition of the Prophet (SAWA)s Ascension, ‘O Muhammad, My love is due to those who love each other for My sake, and My love is due to those who are kind to each other for My sake, and My love is due to those who maintain communication with each other for My sake, and My love is due to those who trust Me, and there is no ensign, end or culmination to My love, and whenever I raise an ensign for them I lower another ensign for them.

_source.chapter: That which Brings About the Love of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ اللّهُ تباركَ وتعالى: ما تَحبَّبَ إليَّ عبدي بأحَبَّ مِمّا افْتَرَضتُ علَيهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah, Mighty and Exalted, says, ‘The servant endears himself to Me by no better means than what I have made obligatory upon him.

_source.chapter: That which Brings About the Love of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا تَخَلّى المؤمنُ مِن الدُّنيا سَما ووَجَدَ حَلاوَةَ حُبِّ اللّهِ ، وكانَ عندَ أهلِ الدُّنيا كأنَّهُ قد خُولِطَ ، وإنَّما خالَطَ القَومَ حَلاوَةُ حُبِّ اللّهِ فلَم يَشْتَغلوا بغَيرِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘When the believer abandons this world, he is elevated and finds the sweet taste of Allahs love; he appears to the people of this world as if he is confounded in his mind, whereas truly it is they who have confounded the sweetness of Allahs love such that they do not occupy themselves with other than Him.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ اللّهَ يُحِبُّ الحَيِيَّ الحَليمَ العَفيفَ المُتَعفِّفَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Indeed Allah loves the bashful, clement, chaste and virtuous servant.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ يُحِبُّ كُلَّ قَلبٍ حَزينٍ ، ويُحِبُّ كُلَّ عبدٍ شَكورٍ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘Indeed Allah loves every sorrowful heart and loves every grateful servant.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ يُحِبُّ المُداعِبَ في الجَماعةِ بلا رَفَثٍ ، المتوحِّدَ بالفِكْرَةِ ، المُتَحَلّيَ بالصّبرِ ، المُتَباهيَ بالصَّلاةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Allah loves the one who is jolly among people without being obscene, is monotheistic in his thought, adorned by patience, and priding himself with the prayer.

_source.chapter: The People Loved Most by Allah
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أحَبُّ عِبادِ اللّهِ إلى اللّهِ أنْفَعُهُم لِعبادِهِ، وأقْوَمُهُم بحقِّهِ، الّذينَ يُحَبَّبُ إلَيهِمُ المَعروفُ وفِعالُهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The most beloved of Allahs servants to Him are those that are the most useful to His servants, and the most persistent of them in establishing His right, those who endear virtue and its practices.

_source.chapter: The People Loved Most by Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أحَبُّ العِبادِ إلى اللّهِ عزّ وجلّ رجُلٌ صَدوقٌ في حَديثِهِ ، مُحافِظٌ على صَلَواتِه وما افْتَرَضَ اللّهُ علَيهِ ، مَع أداءِ الأمانَةِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The most beloved of people to Allah, Mighty and Exalted, is a man who is truthful in his speech, careful about his prayer and all that Allah has made obligatory for him, along with returning whatever he is entrusted with.

_source.chapter: The Corollaries of the Love of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا أحَبَّ اللّهُ عَبداً ألْهَمَهُ حُسنَ العِبادَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When Allah loves a servant He inspires him with good acts of devotion.

_source.chapter: The Corollaries of the Love of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن سَرَّهُ أن يَعلمَ أنَّ اللّهَ يُحِبُّهُ فلْيَعْمَلْ بطاعةِ اللّهِ ولْيَتَّبِعْنا ، ألَمْ يَسْمَعْ قَولَ اللّهِ عزّ وجلّ لنَبيّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): «قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ »؟!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever would like to know that Allah loves him must work in the obedience of Allah and follow us. Has he heard not the speech of Allah, Mighty and Exalted, to His Prophet (SAWA): “Say, ‘If you love Allah…”?

_source.chapter: The Status of Mans Position with Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أرادَ أنْ يَعرِفَ كيفَ مَنزِلَتُهُ عِندَ اللّهِ فلْيَعْرِفْ كيفَ مَنزِلَةُ اللّهِ عِندَهُ ، فإنَّ اللّهَ يُنزِلُ العَبدَ مِثلَ ما يُنزِلُ العَبدُ اللّهَ مِن نَفْسِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever wants to know the status of his position with Allah must first find out what status of position Allah holds with him, for Allah places the servant in the same position whereat the servant places Allah with respect to himself.

_source.chapter: The Sign of Mans Love for Allah
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): عَلامَةُ حـُبِّ اللّهِ تعالى حُبُّ ذِكرِ اللّهِ ، وعَلامَةُ بُغْضِ اللّهِ تعالى بُغْضُ ذِكرِ اللّهِ عزّ وجلّ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The sign of [mans] love of Allah is the love of the remembrance of Allah, and the sign of [mans] hatred towards Allah is his hatred towards the remembrance of Allah, Mighty and Exalted.

_source.chapter: The Sign of Mans Love for Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ فيما أوْحى اللّهُ تعالى إلى موسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: كَذبَ مَن زَعَمَ أنَّهُ يُحِبُّني فإذا جَنَّهُ اللّيلُ نامَ عَنّي، أليسَ كُلُّ مُحِبٍّ يُحِبُّ خَلْوةَ حَبيبِهِ؟!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, regarding what Allah, most High, revealed to Prophet Moses (AS), said, ‘He lies who claims that he loves Me, yet when the night covers him up he sleeps away from Me [forgetting Me]. Is it not that every lover loves to be alone with his beloved?!

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): قالَ اللّهُ: ما تَحبَّبَ إلَيّ عَبدي بشيءٍ أحَبَّ إلَيَّ ممّا افْتَرَضْتُهُ علَيهِ ، وإنّهُ لَيَتحبَّبُ إلَيَّ بالنّافِلَةِ حتّى اُحِبَّهُ ، فإذا أحْبَبْتُهُ كنتُ سَمْعَهُ الّذي يَسمَعُ بهِ، وبَصرَهُ الّذي يُبصِرُ بهِ ، ولِسانَهُ الّذي يَنْطِقُ بهِ ، ويَدَهُ الّتي يَبْطِشُ بها ، ورِجْلَهُ الّتي يَمشي بها، إذا دَعاني أجَبْتُهْ، وإذا سَألَني أعْطَيتُهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah, Mighty and Exalted, says, “My servant endears himself to Me with nothing more beloved to Me than what I have made obligatory upon him, and he endears himself to Me through performance of the supererogatory prayers until I love him. Once I love him, I become his hearing with which he hears, his sight with which he sees, his tongue with which he speaks, his hands with which he acts, and his foot with which he walks. When he calls Me I answer him, and when he asks Me I grant him.”

_source.chapter: The Incongruity of the Love of Allah Combined with the Love of the World
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): حُبُّ الدُّنيا وحُبُّ اللّهِ لا يَجْتَمِعانِ في قَلبٍ أبداً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The love for Allah and the love for the world cannot ever coexist in one heart.
_source.chapter_ar: عَدَمُ اجتِماعِ حُبِّ اللّهِ وحُبِّ الدُّنيا

_source.chapter: The Incongruity of the Love of Allah Combined with the Love of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّهِ ، ما أحَبَّ اللّهَ مَن أحَبَّ الدُّنيا ووالَى غَيرَنا.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘By Allah, Allah does not love him who loves this world and befriends other than us.
_source.chapter_ar: عَدَمُ اجتِماعِ حُبِّ اللّهِ وحُبِّ الدُّنيا

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): قالَ اللّهُ عزّ وجلّ لداوودَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أحْبِبْني وحَبِّبْني إلى خَلْقي . قالَ: يا رَبِّ ، نَعَم أنا اُحِبُّكَ ، فكيفَ اُحَبِّبُكَ إلى خَلْقِكَ ؟ قالَ: اذْكُرْ أيادِيَّ عِندَهُم ، فإنَّكَ إذا ذَكَرْتَ لَهُم ذلكَ أحَبّوني.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah, Mighty and Exalted, said to Prophet David (AS), “Love Me and encourage My creatures to love Me.” He said, ‘My Lord, I do love You, but how can I encourage Your creatures to love You? Allah said, “Remind them of My blessing and kindness, for if you remind them of that they will love Me.”

_source.chapter: To Love for the Sake of Allah
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أفْضَلُ الأعْمالِ الحُبُّ في اللّهِ والبُغْضُ في اللّهِ تعالى .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The best of practices is to love for the sake of Allah and to hate for the sake of Allah, most High.

_source.chapter: To Love for the Sake of Allah
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ لبعضِ أصحابهِ ـ: يا عبدَ اللّهِ، أحْبِب في اللّهِ ، وأبغِضْ في اللّهِ، ووالِ في اللّهِ، وعادِ في اللّهِ، فإنَّهُ لا تُنالُ وَلايةُ اللّهِ إلّا بذلكَ، ولا يَجِدُ رَجُلٌ طَعْمَ الإيمانِ ـ وإنْ كَثُرَتْ صَلاتُهُ وصِيامُهُ ـ حتّى يكونَ كذلكَ، وقد صارَتْ مُؤاخاةُ النّاسِ يَومَكُم هذا أكْثَرُها في الدُّنيا ، علَيها يَتَوادّونَ ، وعلَيها يَتَباغَضُونَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said to one of his companions, ‘O servant of Allah! Love for the sake of Allah and hate for the sake of Allah, and befriend for the sake of Allah and contest for the sake of Allah, for Allahs guardianship is attained only by that, and man will not find the taste of faith — though his prayers and fasting be much — unless he behaves thus. In this present day, the brotherhood and friendship of the people are mainly for the sake of this world; they love each other for its sake and hate each other for its sake.

_source.chapter: To Love for the Sake of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما الْتَقى مُؤمِنانِ قَطُّ إلّا كانَ أفْضَلُهُما أشَدَّهُما حُبّاً لأخيهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘No sooner do two believers meet than the better of them is he who loves his brother more.

_source.chapter: To Love for the Sake of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ مَن لَم يُحِبَّ على الدِّينِ ولَم يُبغِضْ على الدِّينِ، فلا دِينَ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Every single person who does not love for religion or hate for religion has no religion.

_source.chapter: To Love for the Sake of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الجوادُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أوْحى اللّهُ إلى بعضِ الأنبياءِ: أمّا زُهدُكَ في الدُّنيا فَتُعَجِّلُكَ الرّاحَةَ ، وأمّا انْقِطاعُكَ إلَيَّ فيُعَزّزُكَ بِي ، ولكنْ هَل عادَيْتَ لي عَدُوّا ووالَيْتَ لي وَليّا؟
_source.english: Imam al-Jawad (AS) said, ‘Allah revealed to one of the prophets, “Your asceticism in this world hastens your comfort, and your devotion to Me endears you to Me. But did you oppose an enemy [of Mine] for My sake or did you befriend a friend for Me?”

_source.chapter: The Love of the Prophet (SAWA) and His Household (AS)
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا يُؤمنُ عَبدٌ حتّى أكونَ أحَبَّ إلَيهِ مِن نَفْسِهِ ، وتَكونَ عِتْرَتي إلَيهِ أعَزَّ مِن عِتْرَتِهِ ، ويكونَ أهْلي أحَبَّ إلَيهِ مِن أهْلِهِ، وتكونَ ذاتي أحَبَّ إلَيهِ مِن ذاتِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Man is not considered a believer until I am dearer to him than his own self, my household dearer to him than his own household, my family dearer to him than his own family, and my being dearer to him than his own being.
_source.chapter_ar: حُبُّ النبيّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) وأهلِ بيتِه (عَلَيهِمُ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The Love of the Prophet (SAWA) and His Household (AS)
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أحِبّوا اللّهَ لِما يَغْدوكُم بهِ مِن نِعَمِهِ، وأحِبّوني لِحُبِّ اللّهِ ، وأحِبّوا أهْلَ بَيْتي لِحُبّي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Love Allah for the blessings that He bestows on you every morning; love me because of the love of Allah; and love my household because of love for me.
_source.chapter_ar: حُبُّ النبيّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) وأهلِ بيتِه (عَلَيهِمُ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The Love of the Prophet (SAWA) and His Household (AS)
_source.arabic: قالَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أحَبَّنا أهلَ البيتِ فلْيَحْمَدِ اللّهَ على أوَّلِ النِّعَمِ. قلت: وما أولى النِّعَمِ؟ قالَ: طِيبُ الوِلادَةِ، ولا يُحِبُّنا إلّا مَن طابَتْ وِلادَتُهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who loves us, the holy household, let him praise Allah for the first blessing. He was asked, ‘What is the first blessing? to which he replied, ‘Legitimate birth, for only he loves us whose birth [i.e. conception] is legitimate.
_source.chapter_ar: حُبُّ النبيّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) وأهلِ بيتِه (عَلَيهِمُ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The Love of the Prophet (SAWA) and His Household (AS)
_source.arabic: عن الحارِثِ الهَمْدانيِ: أتيتُ أميرَالمؤمِنينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ذاتَ يَومٍ نصفَ النَّهارِ، فقالَ: ما جاءَ بكَ؟ قلتُ: حُبُّكَ واللّهِ . قالَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنْ كنتَ صادِقاً لَتراني في ثَلاثةِ مَواطِنَ: حَيثُ تَبْلُغُ نَفْسُكَ هذهِ ـ وأوْمَأ بيدِهِ إلى حَنْجَرَتِهِ ـ وعِند الصِّراطِ، وعِند الحَوضِ.
_source.english: It is narrated in al-Daawat on the authority of al-Harith al-Hamdani, ‘One day I went to visit the Commander of the Faithful (AS) at noon. He asked, ‘What has brought you here? I answered, ‘By Allah, it is love for you. He said, ‘If you are truthful, you will see me at three positions: when your soul comes to this - and then he pointed to his throat -, on the Bridge [outstretched over Hell], and at the Heavenly Waters.
_source.chapter_ar: حُبُّ النبيّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) وأهلِ بيتِه (عَلَيهِمُ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The Love of the Prophet (SAWA) and His Household (AS)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قولهِ تعالى: «فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالعُرْوَةِ الوُثْقَى»ـ: مَودَّتُنا أهلَ البَيتِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, regarding the verse of Allah, most High:“He has held fast to the firmest handle” [Quran 2:256], said, ‘It is love for us, the Prophets household (ahl al-bayt).
_source.chapter_ar: حُبُّ النبيّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) وأهلِ بيتِه (عَلَيهِمُ الّسَلامُ)

_source.chapter: The Conditions for Loving the Household
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّهِ ، ما مَعنا مِن اللّهِ بَراءةٌ ، ولابَيْنَنا وبَينَ اللّهِ قَرابَةٌ، ولا لَنا على اللّهِ حُجَّةٌ ، ولانَتَقرَّبُ إلى اللّهِ إلّا بالطّاعَةِ، فمَن كانَ مِنكُم مُطيعاً للّهِ تَنْفَعُهُ ولايَتُنا ، ومَن كانَ مِنكُم عاصياً للّهِ لَم تَنْفَعْهُ وَلايَتُنا . ويْحَكُم لا تَغْتَرّوا! ويْحَكُم لاتَغْتَرّوا!
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘By Allah, we have no acquittance from Allah, nor is there kinship between Allah and us, nor do we possess a [special] argument against Allah, nor do we attain proximity to Allah except through His obedience. So whosoever from among you is obedient to Allah, our friendship will benefit him, and whosoever from among you is disobedient to Allah, our friendship will be of no use to him. Woe unto you, do not be deceived! Woe unto you, do not be deceived!
_source.chapter_ar: ما يُشتَرَطُ في حُبِّ أهلِ البَيتِ (عَلَيهِمُ الّسَلامُ)

_source.arabic: الإمام عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الإمامُ عليٌّ عليه السلام: لَو أحَبَّني جَبلٌ لَتَهافَتَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If a mountain were to love me, it would crumble.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ عليه السلام إذ جاءهُ رجُلٌ فقالَ: واللّه ، إنّي لاَُحِبُّكُم أهلَ البَيتِ : فاتَّخِذْ للبَلاء جِلْبابا ؛ فواللّه إنَّهُ لَأسْرَعُ إلَينا وإلى شِيعَتِنا مِن السَّيلِ في الوادي ، وبِنا يَبْدأ البَلاءُ ثُمَّ بِكُم ، وبِنا يَبْدأ الرَّخاءُ ثُمَّ بِكُم .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS), when a man came to him saying, ‘By Allah, I love you O Household of the Prophet, replied, ‘Then wear the garment of tribulation, for by Allah it overcomes us and our followers faster than the flood in the valley. Tribulation begins with us and then you, and prosperity too starts with us and then you.

_source.chapter: Man is with Whom He Loves
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): المَرءُ مَعَ مَن أحَبَّ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Man is with him whom he loves.

_source.chapter: Man is with Whom He Loves
_source.arabic: سألَ رجُلٌ رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) عنِ السّاعةِ، فقالَ: ما أعْدَدْتَ لَها؟ قالَ: ما أعْدَدْتُ لَها كبيراً، إلّا أنّي اُحِبُّ اللّهَ ورسولَهُ. قالَ: فأنتَ مَع مَن أحْبَبْتَ .
_source.english: A man asked the Prophet (SAWA) about the Final Hour, to whom he asked in turn, ‘What have you done to prepare for it? The man replied, ‘I have not prepared much for it, but I do love Allah and His Messenger. The Prophet said, ‘Then you will be with whom you love.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : الشَّبابُ شُعْبَةٌ مِن الجُنونِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Youth is a branch of madness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِدَّةُ ضَرْبٌ مِن الجُنونِ ؛ لأنَّ صاحِبَها يَنْدَمُ ، فإنْ لَم يَنْدَمْ فجُنونُهُ مُسْتَحكِمٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Irascibility is a type of madness, since its perpetrator always regrets. If however, he does not regret, his madness is confirmed.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ مَن أجابَ في كلِّ ما يُسْألُ عَنهُ لَمَجْنونٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever answers to everything that is asked of him has gone mad.

_source.arabic: مَرَّ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) بمَجْنونٍ ، فقالَ: ما لَهُ ؟ فقيلَ : إنّهُ مَجْنونٌ ، فقالَ : بَلْ هُو مُصابٌ، إنَّما المَجْنونُ مَن آثَرَ الدُّنيا على الآخِرَةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) passed by an insane person and asked, ‘What is wrong with him? He was told that he had gone mad. The Prophet (SAWA) then remarked, ‘Rather, he is afflicted. The one who has gone mad is the one who prefers this world to the next.

_source.arabic: مَرَّ برسولِ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) رجُلٌ وهو في أصْحابِهِ ، فقالَ بعضُ القَومِ: مَجْنونٌ! فقالَ النّبيُّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : بَلْ هذا رجُلٌ مُصابٌ، إنّما المَجْنونُ عَبدٌ أو أمَةٌ أبْلَيا شَبابَهُما في غَيرِ طاعةِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: A man passed by the Prophet (SAWA) while he was sitting with his companions. One of them mentioned that he had gone mad. The Prophet (SAWA) replied, ‘This man is, in fact, afflicted, since truly one who is mad, be he male or female, is one who has squandered his youth in other than Allahs obedience.

_source.arabic: مَرَّ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) بِرَجُلٍ مَصْروعٍ ... فقالَ : ما هذا بمَجْنونٍ ، ألاَ اُخبِرُكُم بالمَجْنونِ حقَّ المَجْنونِ ؟ ....قالَ: إنَّ المَجْنونَ حقَّ المَجْنونِ المُتَبَخْتِرُ في مِشْيتِهِ ، النّاظِرُ في عِطْفَيْهِ ، المُحَرِّكُ جَنْبَيهِ بمِنْكَبَيْهِ ، فذَاكَ المَجْنونُ وهذا المُبْتلى .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) passed by one who was affected by madness, and said, ‘Shall I inform you of one who is truly mad? Then he said, ‘Indeed one who is mad is one who is haughty in his gait, looking over his shoulders, and swinging his sides from side to side. That is one who is mad and this is one afflicted.

_source.chapter: Caution against Doing Something That One Would Later Have to Excuse Oneself For
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إيّاكَ وما تَعتَذِرُ مِنهُ ؛ فإنَّ فيهِ الشِّركَ الخَفِيَّ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Misbah al-Shariaa (Lantern of the Path) that the Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Keep away from doing that which you must excuse yourself for, for verily that involves hidden polytheism.

_source.chapter: Caution against Doing Something That One Would Later Have to Excuse Oneself For
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إيّاكَ وما تَعتَذِرُ مِنهُ ؛ فإنَّ المُؤمِنَ لا يُسيءُ ولا يَعتَذِرُ ، والمُنافِقَ كُلَّ يَومٍ يُسيءُ ويَعتَذِرُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘Keep away from doing that which you must excuse yourself for, for verily the believer neither commits a wrong nor makes excuses for himself, whereas the hypocrite commits wrongs and makes excuses for them everyday.

_source.chapter: Caution against Doing Something That One Would Later Have to Excuse Oneself For
_source.arabic: مُفَضّلِ بنِ عُمرَ: قالَ أبو عَبدِ اللّهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَنبَغي لِلمُؤمِنِ أن يُذِلَّ نَفسَهُ ، قُلتُ: بِما يُذِلُّ نَفسَهُ ؟ قالَ: يَدخُلُ فيما يَعتَذِرُ مِنهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘A believer must never humiliate himself. When asked how he would humiliate himself, he replied, ‘By embarking upon something which he later has to make excuses for.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Accepting the Excuse of One Who Excuses Himself
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن لَم يَقبَلِ المَعذِرَةَ مِن مُحِقٍّ أو مُبطِلٍ، لَم يَرِدْ عَلَيَّ الحَوضَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who does not accept an apology, be it from an honest man or a liar, will not be with me at the Heavenly Pool [in Paradise].
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى قَبولِ عُذرِ مَنِ اعتَذَرَ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Accepting the Excuse of One Who Excuses Himself
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِقبَلْ عُذرَ أخيكَ، وإن لَم يَكُن لَهُ عُذرٌ فَالتَمِسْ لَهُ عُذرا.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Accept your fellow brothers excuse, and if he has no excuse then find an excuse for him.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى قَبولِ عُذرِ مَنِ اعتَذَرَ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Accepting the Excuse of One Who Excuses Himself
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أعقَلُ النّاسِ أعذَرُهُم لِلنّاسِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most understanding person is he who accepts peoples excuses most readily.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى قَبولِ عُذرِ مَنِ اعتَذَرَ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Accepting the Excuse of One Who Excuses Himself
_source.arabic: الإمام زين العابدين (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إن شَتَمَكَ رَجُلٌ عَن يَمينِكَ ثُمّ تَحَوَّلَ إلى يَسارِكَ واعتَذَرَ إلَيكَ فَاقبَلْ عُذرَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘If someone insults you on your right hand side, then moves over to your left and apologises to you, accept his apology.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلى قَبولِ عُذرِ مَنِ اعتَذَرَ

_source.arabic: رسولِ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : ما شَيءٌ أكرمُ علَى اللّهِ مِن ابنِ آدمَ . قيلَ : يا رسولَ اللّهِ ، ولا الملائكةُ؟! قالَ: الملائكةُ مَجْبورونَ ، بمنزلةِ الشّمسِ والقمرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Nothing is more honored by Allah than the son of Adam. He was asked, ‘Not even the angels, O Messenger of Allah? He said, ‘The angels are compelled [by predestination] like the sun and the moon.

_source.arabic: رسولِ اللّه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : لَيس شَيءٌ خَيراً مِن ألْفٍ مِثلِهِ إلّا الإنسانَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Nothing is better than a thousand of its like, except for man.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سألَهُ عبدُ اللّهِ بنُ سِنانٍ : الملائكةُ أفضلُ أمْ بَنو آدمَ ؟ ـ : قالَ أميرُ المؤمنينَ عليُّ بنُ أبي طالبٍ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّ اللّهَ عزّ وجلّ ركّبَ في الملائكةِ عقلاً بلا شَهوةٍ ، وركّبَ في البهائمِ شَهوةً بلا عقلٍ، وركّبَ في بني آدمَ كِلْتَيْهما ، فمَنْ غلَبَ عقلُهُ شهوتَهُ فَهُو خيرٌ مِن الملائكةِ ، ومَن غلَبتْ شَهوتُهُ عقلَهُ فهُو شَرٌّ مِن البهائمِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), when 'Abdullah b. Sinan asked him, ‘Is man better or the angels?, replied, ‘The Commander of the Faithful (AS) said, ‘Allah, the Exalted, gave the angels intellect without desire, He gave the beasts desire without intellect, and He gave both to the sons of Adam. So a man whose intellect prevails over his desire is better than the angels whilst a man whose desire prevails over his intellect is worse that the beasts.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بتقوَى اللّهِ اُمِرْتُم ، وللإحسانِ والطّاعةِ خُلِقْتُم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘You were ordered to fear Allah and you were created for obedience and good deeds.
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:3, number:108

_source.arabic: الإمام الصّادق (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : خَرجَ الحسينُ بنُ عَليٍ على أصحابِهِ فَقالَ : أيّها النّاسُ ، إنّ اللّهَ ـ عزّ وجلّ ذِكْرُهُ ـ ما خَلقَ العِبادَ إلّا لِيَعرِفوهُ ، فإذا عَرفُوهُ عَبَدوهُ ، فإذا عَبَدوهُ اسْتَغنَوا بعِبادتِهِ عن عبادةِ ما سِواهُ . فقالَ لَه رجلٌ : يا بنَ رسولِ اللّهِ ، بأبي أنتَ واُمّي فما معرفةُ اللّهِ؟ قالَ : معرفةُ أهلِ كلِّ زمانٍ إمامَهُمُ الّذي يَجبُ علَيهِم طاعتُهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘O People! Allah, exalted be His remembrance, has only created people so that they might know Him; and when they know Him they worship Him; and when they worship Him they become needless of worshipping others by His worship. A man asked him, ‘O son of the Prophet! May my parents be your ransom, what is meant by knowing Allah? He replied, ‘It is that the people of each era must know their Imam, to whom obedience is mandatory.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في جَوابِ زِنديقٍ سألَهُ : فَلِأيِّ عِلّةٍ خَلقَ الخَلقَ وهُو غيرُ مُحتاجٍ إليهِم ولا مُضْطرٍّ إلى خَلْقِهِم ، ولا يَليقُ بهِ التَّعَبُّثُ بِنا ؟ ـ : خلَقَهُم لإظهارِ حِكمتِهِ ، وإنْفاذِ علمِهِ ، وإمْضاءِ تَدبيرِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), when an atheist asked him, ‘For what purpose did He create humanity if He had no need for them and neither was he compelled to create them, and nor would it be proper for Him to create us in vain?, replied, ‘He created them to reveal [to them] His wisdom, to execute His knowledge, and to carry out His plan.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قولهِ تعالى : «ولا يَزالونَ مُختلفينَ * إلّا مَن رَحِمَ ربُّكَ ولذلكَ خَلَقهم» ـ: خَلقَهُم لِيَفعَلوا ما يَسْتَوجِبونَ بهِ رَحمتَه فيَرْحَمَهُم.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, regarding the verse, but they continue to differ, except those on whom your Lord has mercy —and that is why He created them”, ‘He created them so that they may perform that which will render them deserving of the mercy of Allah, so that He may confer his mercy upon them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مِسكينٌ ابنُ آدمَ ! مَكْتومُ الأجَلِ ، مَكْنونُ العِلَلِ ، مَحْفوظُ العَملِ ، تُؤْلِمُهُ البَقَّةُ ، وتَقتُلُهُ الشَّرْقَةُ ، وتُنْتِنُهُ العَرْقَةُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Pitiable is the son of Adam! His death is hidden [from him], his illnesses are invisible, and his actions are recorded. A mosquito causes him pain, a gasp can kill him, and a little sweat makes him stink.
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:20, p. 62

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : المرءُ بأصغَرَيْهِ : بقلبِهِ ولسانِهِ ، إنْ قاتَلَ قاتَلَ بجَنانٍ ، وإن نَطقَ نَطقَ ببَيانٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Man [‘s worth] is measured according to his two little organs: his heart and his tongue - so that when he fights, he should do so with a firm heart, and when he speaks, he should do so with eloquence.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المُلكُ سِياسَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Sovereignty is [efficient] management.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): آفَةُ الزُّعَماءِ ضَعفُ السِّياسَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The downfall of leading politicians is [due to] their poor management.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حُسنُ السِّياسَةِ يَستَدِيمُ الرِّياسةَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Good management prolongs one's [term of] leadership.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حُسنُ السِّياسَةِ قِوامُ الرَّعِيَّةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Good management acts as a support for one's subjects.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حسُنُ التَّدبيرِ وتَجَنَّبُ التَّبذيرِ من حُسنِ السِّياسَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Efficient organisation and avoidance of squandering is part of good management.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سُوءُ التَّدبيرِ سَبَبُ التَّدميرِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Disorganisation is the cause of destruction.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِلاكُ السِّياسَةِ العَدلُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The yardstick of good management is justice.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رَأسُ السِّياسَةِ استِعمالُ الرِّفقِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The peak of good management is the employment of moderation.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الاحتِمالُ زَينُ السِّياسَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Tolerance is the adornment of management.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن ساسَ نَفسَهُ أدرَكَ السِّياسَةَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He who is able to manage his own self truly understands management.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سُوسُوا أنفُسَكُم بالوَرَعِ ، وداوُوا مَرضاكُم بالصَّدَقَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Manage your selves with piety, and cure the sick ones from among you with charity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن حَقِّ المَلِكِ أن يَسُوسَ نَفسَهُ قَبلَ جُندِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'It is the duty of a king to manage his own self before his army.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): السُّوقُ دارُ سَهْوٍ وغَفلَةٍ ، فَمَن سَبَّحَ فيها تَسبِيحَةً كَتَبَ اللّهُ لَهُ بها ألفَ ألفِ حَسَنةٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The market is a place of distraction and negligence, so whoever occupies himself therein with the glorification of Allah, Allah records for him the worth of a million good deeds.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) مِن كتابٍ لَهُ إلى الحارثِ الهَمْدانِيّ: إيّاكَ ومَقاعِدَ الأسواقِ ؛ فإنّها مَحاضِرُ الشيطانِ ومَعارِيضُ الفِتَنِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) in one of his letters to al-Harith al-Hamdani, said, 'Beware of sitting in the marketplaces for they are the meeting places of Satan and the targets of mischief.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): شَرُّ بِقاعِ الأرضِ الأسواقُ ، وهُو مَيدانُ إبليسَ ، يَغدُو بِرايَتِهِ ، ويَضَعُ كُرسِيَّهُ ، ويَبُثُّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ ، فَبَينَ مُطَفِّفٍ في قَفيزٍ ، أو طائشٍ في ميزانٍ ، أو سارِقٍ في ذِراعٍ ، أو كاذِبٍ في سِلعَتِهِ ، فيقولُ: علَيكُم بِرَجُلٍ ماتَ أبوهُ وأبُوكُم حَيٌّ ، فلا يَزالُ مع أوَّلِ مَن يَدخُلُ وآخِرِ مَن يَرجِعُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'The most evil of places on earth are the marketplaces, for it is Satan's domain where he unfurls his flag first in the morning, takes up his seat and gives free rein to his offspring, from a vendor niggardly with his measure, to one who is reckless with his scale, to one who thieves off metres [from cloth], or to one who lies about his wares; to all he says, 'Take advantage of this man whose father has probably died [and has left him with an inheritance and no responsibility] whilst your own father is still alive. And he continues to do this from the first one to enter therein to the last one to leave.

_source.chapter: Imam Ali (AS)'s Exhortation to Market Traders
_source.arabic: بحار الأنوار عن أبي سعيد: كانَ عَلِيٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) يَأتِي السُّوقَ فيقولُ: يا أهلَ السُّوقِ اِتَّقُوا اللّهَ ، وإيّاكُم والحَلفَ فإنّهُ يُنَفِّقُ السِّلعَةَ ، ويَمحَقُ البَرَكَةَ ، وإنَّ التاجِرَ فاجِرٌ إلّا مَن أخَذَ الحَقَّ وأعطاهُ ، السَّلامُ علَيكُم . ثُمَّ يَمكُثُ الأيّامَ ثُمّ يَأتي فَيقولُ مِثلَ مَقالَتِهِ.
_source.english: Abu Saaid narrated that Imam Ali (AS) used to come to the market and exhort, 'O market traders, fear Allah and beware of making false oaths, for though it may sell your goods, it eradicates all benediction thereof. The trader [by nature] is corrupt, except those who take only their right, and give back the right due, and upon you be peace. Then a few days would pass, and he would come there again and exhort them as he did before. And when he would arrive, people would say, 'Here comes the big-bellied man', to which he would reply, 'The bottom of it may be food, but the top is knowledge.
_source.chapter_ar: مَوعِظَةُ الإمامِ عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) لِأهلِ السُّوقِ

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أحَبَّ أن يَلقَى اللّهَ طاهِراً مُطَهَّراً فَلْيَلْقَهُ بزَوجَةٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whoever wants to meet Allah pure and immaculate should meet him accompanied by a wife.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما بُنِيَ في الإسلامِ بِناءٌ أحَبَّ إلى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ ، وأعَزَّ مِنَ التَّزويجِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'There is no institution in Islam more beloved and dearer to Allah than marriage.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): النِّكاحُ سُنَّتِي ، فَمَن رَغِبَ عَن سُنَّتي فَلَيسَ مِنّي .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Marriage is my practice, so whoever rejects my practice is not from me.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما مِن شابٍّ تَزَوَّجَ في حَداثَةِ سِنِّهِ إلّا عَجَّ شَيطانُهُ: يا وَيْلَهُ ، يا وَيْلَهُ ! عَصَمَ مِنّي ثُلُثَي دِينِهِ ، فَلْيَتَّقِ اللّهَ العَبدُ في الثُّلُثِ الباقِي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'When any young person gets married at the prime of his youth, his inner Satan cries out in rage, 'Woe unto him! Woe unto him! Two thirds of his faith have now been secured against me, and he has only to be careful of his duty to Allah in the remaining third.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا تَزَوَّجَ العَبدُ فقدِ استَكمَلَ نِصفَ الدينِ ، فَلْيَتَّقِ اللّهَ في النِّصفِ الباقي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'When the servant gets married, he has completed half of his faith, so let him be careful of his duty to Allah in the remaining half.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): المُتَزَوِّجُ النائمُ أفضَلُ عِندَ اللّهِ مِنَ الصائمِ القائمِ العَزَبِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'A married person sleeping is better in the sight of Allah than an unmarried person spending his night in fast and prayer.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِتَّخِذُوا الأهلَ؛ فإنّه أرْزَقُ لَكُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Take up a wife for verily that will bring about an increase in your sustenance.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): زَوِّجُوا أياماكُم ، فَإنَّ اللّهَ يُحسِنُ لَهُم في أخلاقِهِم ، ويُوَسِّعُ لَهُم في أرزاقِهِم ، ويَزِيدُهُم في مُرُوّاتِهِم .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Marry those who are single among you for verily Allah will develop their moral traits [through marriage], He will increase their sustenance for them, and will enhance their integrity and gallantry.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رَكعَتانِ يُصَلّيهِما مُتَزَوِّجٌ أفضَلُ مِن سَبعينَ رَكعَةً يُصَلِّيها غيرُ مُتَزَوِّجٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'A two-unit prayer performed by a married person is better than seventy units performed by an unmarried person.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): شِرارُ مَوتاكُمُ العُزّابُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The worst ones from among your dead are the single people.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): شِرارُكُم عُزّابُكُم ، رَكعَتانِ مِن مُتَأهِّلٍ خَيرٌ مِن سَبعِينَ ركعةً مِن غَيرِ مُتَأهِّلٍ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The worst ones from among you are the single ones; two units of prayer performed by a married person is better than seventy units performed by an unmarried person.

_source.chapter: The Reward for Getting Fellow Muslims Married
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن زَوَّجَ أعزَبا كانَ مِمَّن يَنظُرُ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ إلَيهِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'He who arranges for a single person to get married will be amongst those whom Allah will regard [with mercy] on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.chapter: The Reward for Getting Fellow Muslims Married
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثلاثةٌ يَستَظِلُّونَ بِظِلِّ عَرشِ اللّهِ يَومَ لا ظِلَّ إلّا ظِلُّهُ: رَجُلٌ زَوَّجَ أخاهُ المسلمَ ، أو أخدَمَهُ ، أو كَتَمَ لَهُ سِرّاً.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, 'There are three types of people who will be shaded by Allah's Throne on the Day when no shade will avail apart from it: the one who arranged the marriage of a fellow Muslim brother, or served him in some way, or concealed his Muslim brother's faults [from others].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): نَزَلَ جَبرئيلُ على النبِيّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) فقالَ: يا محمّدُ ، إنّ رَبَّكَ يُقرِئُكَ السلامَ ، ويقولُ: إنّ الأبكارَ مِنَ النساءِ بمَنزِلَةِ الثَّمَرِ على الشَّجَرِ، فإذا أينَعَ الثَّمرُ فلا دَواءَ لَهُ إلّا اجتِناؤهُ وإلّا أفسَدَتْهُ الشَّمسُ ، وغَيَّرَتْهُ الرِّيحُ ، وإنّ الأبكارَ إذا أدرَكنَ ما تُدرِكُ النساءُ فلا دَواءَ لَهُنَ إلّا البُعُولُ، وإلّا لَم يُؤمَنْ علَيهِنَّ الفِتنَةُ، فَصَعِدَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) المِنبَرَ فَجَمَعَ الناسَ ثُمّ أعلَمَهُم ما أمَرَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ بِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, 'The archangel Gabriel descended to the Prophet (SAWA) and told him, 'O Muhammad, verily your Lord extends salutations on you and says, 'Verily the virgins from among your women are as fruits on a tree, which when they ripen must be plucked otherwise the sun rots them and the wind alters them. So when young women reach marriageable age, they have no other recourse apart from husbands, otherwise they will not be safe from corruption. The Prophet (SAWA) then climbed the pulpit, gathered the people and informed them of what Allah had commanded him.

_source.chapter: The Importance of Faith When Selecting a Spouse
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن تَزَوَّجَ امرَأةً لا يَتَزَوَّجُها إلّا لِجَمالِها لَم يَرَ فيها ما يُحِبُّ ، ومَن تَزَوَّجَها لِمالِها لا يَتَزَوَّجُها إلّا وَكَلَهُ اللّهُ إلَيهِ ، فعلَيكُم بذاتِ الدِّينِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who marries a woman solely for her beauty will not find anything he likes in her, he who marries her for her wealth will be deprived of it as soon as he marries her, so look to marry women of faith.

_source.chapter: The Importance of Faith When Selecting a Spouse
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا يُختارُ حُسنُ وَجهِ المَرأةِ على حسُنِ دِينِها.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The beauty of a woman's faith must be given priority over the beauty of her face.

_source.chapter: The Importance of Faith When Selecting a Spouse
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا جاءَكُم مَن تَرضَونَ دِينَهُ وأمانَتَهُ يَخطُبُ (إلَيكُم) فَزَوِّجُوهُ ، إن لا تَفعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتنَةٌ في الأرضِ وفَسادٌ كبيرٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'When someone comes to you with a proposal and you are well-pleased with his faith and his integrity then accept him in marriage, for if you do not, discord and corruption will prevail in the land.

_source.chapter: The Importance of Faith When Selecting a Spouse
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لرجل جاءَ إلَيهِ يَستَشِيرُهُ في تَزويجِ ابنَتِهِ ـ: زَوِّجْها مِن رَجُلٍ تَقِيٍّ ، فإنّهُ إن أحَبَّها أكرَمَها وإن أبغَضَها لَم يَظلِمْها .
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said to man who came to ask his advice about getting his daughter married, 'Marry her to a pious man, for if he loves her he will honour her, and if he comes to dislike her, at least he will not be unjust towards her.

_source.chapter: The Censure of Demanding an Excessive Dowry
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أفضَلُ نِساءِ اُمَّتِي أصبَحُهُنَّ وَجهاً وأقَلُّهُنَّ مَهراً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The best women of my community are those that have the prettiest faces and the smallest dowries.

_source.chapter: The Censure of Demanding an Excessive Dowry
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): خَيرُ الصَّداقِ أيسَرُهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The best dowry is the simplest one.

_source.chapter: The Censure of Demanding an Excessive Dowry
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أمّا شُؤمُ المَرأةِ فكَثرَةُ مَهرِها وعُقوقُ زَوجِها.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'The bane of a woman is her excessive dowry and her disrespect of her husband.

_source.chapter: The Importance of Careful Spouse Selection
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَزَوَّجُوا في الحِجْزِ الصالِحِ، فإنّ العِرْقَ دَسّاسٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Marry into a good tribe for verily what is bred-in-the-bone will come out in the flesh.

_source.chapter: The Importance of Careful Spouse Selection
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَخَيَّرُوا لِنُطَفِكُم ، فإنَّ النساءَ يَلِدْنَ أشباهَ إخوانِهِنَّ وأخَواتِهِنَّ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Choose carefully for your seed, for verily women give birth to children who resemble their own brothers and sisters.

_source.chapter: The Importance of Careful Spouse Selection
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إيّاكُم وخَضْراءَ الدِّمَنِ ، قيلَ: يا رسولَ اللّهِ، وما خَضراءُ الدِّمَنِ ؟ قالَ: المَرأةُ الحَسناءُ في مَنبِتِ السُّوءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, addressing the people, 'Beware of the verdure growing in manure. When asked what verdure growing in manure was, he replied, 'It is the beautiful woman that comes from an evil environment.

_source.chapter: The Importance of Careful Spouse Selection
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إيّاكُم وتَزَوُّجَ الحَمْقاءِ، فإنَّ صُحبَتَها ضَياعٌ ووُلْدَها ضِباعٌ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Beware of marrying a stupid girl for her company is a waste and her offspring are [like] hyenas.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أعظَمُ الناسِ حَقّاً على المرأةِ زَوجُها ، وأعظَمُ الناسِ حقّاً عَلَى الرَّجُلِ اُمُّهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The person with the greatest right over a woman is her husband, and the person with the greatest right over a man is his mother.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ويلٌ لاِمرَأةٍ أغضَبَتْ زَوجَها ، وطُوبى لاِمرَأةٍ رَضِيَ عنها زَوجُها .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Woe unto the woman who angers her husband, and blessed is the woman whose husband is pleased with her.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَو أمَرتُ أحَدا أن يَسجُدَ لِأَحَدٍ لَأَمَرتُ المرأةَ أن تَسجُدَ لِزَوجِها.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If I was in a position to command anyone to prostrate in front of anyone else, I would command the woman to prostrate in front of her husband.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما زالَ جَبرَئيلُ يُوصِينِي بالمرأةِ حتّى ظَنَنتُ أنَّهُ لا يَنبَغِي طَلاقُها إلّا مِن فاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The archangel Gabriel continues to bring down so much advice with regard to the [treatment of the] woman that I think she must never be divorced unless she has committed adultery.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): حَقُّ المرأةِ على زَوجِها أن يَسُدَّ جَوعَتَها، وأن يَستُرَ عَورَتَها ، ولا يُقَبِّحَ لَها وَجها.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The right of a woman on her husband is that he feeds her, clothes her, and does not cause her to lose face [by insulting her or chiding her].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): قَولُ الرَّجُلِ للمرأةِ: «إنّي اُحِبُّكِ» لا يَذهَبُ مِن قَلبِها أبداً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'A man's telling his wife 'I love you' never leaves her heart.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أيُّما امرَأةٍ خَدَمَتْ زَوجَها سَبعَةَ أيّامٍ ، غَلَّقَ اللّهُ عَنها سَبعةَ أبوابِ النارِ وفَتَحَ لَها ثمانِيَةَ أبوابِ الجَنَّةِ تَدخُلُ مِن أينَما شاءَتْ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whichever woman serves her husband for seven days, Allah locks seven doors of Hell to her and opens eight doors of Paradise instead whereof she may enter as she pleases.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سَألَتْ اُمُّ سَلَمَةَ رسولَ اللّه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) عن فَضلِ النساءِ في خِدمَةِ أزواجِهِنَّ ، فقال: أيُّما امرَأةٍ رَفَعَتْ مِن بَيتِ زَوجِها شيئا مِن مَوضِعٍ إلى مَوضِعٍ تُرِيدُ بهِ صَلاحاً إلّا نَظَرَ اللّهُ إلَيها ، ومَن نَظَرَ اللّهُ إلَيهِ لَم يُعَذِّبْهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated that Umm Salama [the Prophet's wife] asked the Prophet (SAWA) about the status of women when being of service to their husbands, so he (SAWA) replied, 'Any woman who so much as moves something from one place to another in her husband's house with the intention of improving it is regarded with mercy by Allah, and whoever Allah regards [with mercy] He does not punish.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): جِهادُ المَرأةِ حُسنُ التَّبَعُّلِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, 'The sacred war (jihad) of a woman is to be of excellent service to her husband.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا سَقَى الرجلُ امرَأتَهُ اُجِرَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If a man quenches his wife's thirst he is rewarded for it.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): جُلوسُ المَرءِ عندَ عِيالِهِ أحَبُّ إلى اللّهِ تعالى مِنِ اعتِكافٍ في مَسجِدِي هذا.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'A man's sitting beside his family is more beloved in the sight of Allah than his spending the night in worship in this mosque of mine.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيُؤجَرُ في رَفعِ اللُّقمَةِ إلى فِي امرَأتِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily the man who lifts a morsel of food to his wife's mouth is well rewarded.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن كانَ لَهُ امرَأةٌ تُؤذِيهِ لَم يَقبَلِ اللّهُ صلاتَها ولا حَسَنَةً مِن عَمَلِها حتّى تُعِينَهُ وتُرضِيَهُ وإن صامَتِ الدَّهرَ ... وعلى الرَّجُلِ مِثلُ ذلكَ الوِزْرِ والعَذابِ إذا كانَ لَها مُؤذِياً ظالِماً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If a man has a wife who mistreats him, Allah does not accept her daily prayer, nor any other good deed she performs, even if she was to fast all her life, until and unless she relieves him and pleases him…and the husband will bear the same burden and punishment if he mistreats or oppresses his wife.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّي لاَءتَعَجَّبُ مِمَّن يَضرِبُ امرَأتَهُ وهُو بِالضَّربِ أولى مِنها!
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'I am truly astonished at the man who beats his wife when he is more deserving of the beating than her!

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَلعونةٌ مَلعونةٌ امرأةٌ تُؤذِي زَوجَها وتُغِمُّهُ ، وسَعيدةٌ سَعِيدةٌ امرأةٌ تُكرِمُ زَوجَها ولا تُؤذِيهِ وتُطِيعُهُ في جَميعِ أحوالِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Cursed! Cursed indeed is the woman who troubles and distresses her husband; and blessed! Blessed indeed is the woman who honours her husband, does not trouble him and obeys him in all matters.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن صَبَرَ عَلى سُوءِ خُلُقِ امرَأتِهِ واحتَسَبَهُ ، أعطاهُ اللّهُ تعالى بكُلِّ يَومٍ ولَيلةٍ يَصبِرُ علَيها مِنَ الثَّوابِ ما أعطى أيُّوبَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) عَلى بَلائهِ ، وكانَ علَيها مِنَ الوِزْرِ في كُلِّ يَومٍ ولَيلةٍ مِثلُ رَمْلٍ عالِجٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whoever patiently tolerates and puts up with his wife's bad character [for the sake of Allah], for every day and night of his endurance Allah will grant him the same reward as that granted to Prophet Job (AS) for enduring his afflictions, and for every day and night of her evildoing she will bear a burden as heavy as the sandhills of Arabia.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن صَبَرَتْ عَلى سُوءِ خُلُقِ زَوجِها أعطاها مِثلَ (ثَوابِ) آسِيَةَ بنتِ مُزاحِمٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'She who patiently tolerates her husband's bad character will be rewarded equivalent to the reward granted to Asiya bint MuzaIim [Pharaoh's wife].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما استَفادَ المؤمنُ بعدَ تَقوَى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ خَيرا لَهُ مِن زَوجَةٍ صالِحَةٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'There is nothing more beneficial to a believer after his piety and devotion to Allah than a virtuous wife.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): خَيرُ مَتاعِ الدنيا المرأةُ الصالِحَةُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The best source of enjoyment in this world is a virtuous wife.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مِن سَعادَةِ المَرءِ الزوجَةُ الصالِحَةُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'A virtuous wife is part of a man's prosperity.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): شَرُّ الأشياءِ المَرأةُ السَّوءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The most evil of all things is the evil wife.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أغلَبُ الأعداءِ للمؤمِنِ زَوجَةُ السُّوءِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'The believer's worst enemy is an evil wife.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ مِن دعاءِ رسولِ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنِ امرَأةٍ تُشَيِّبُني قَبلَ مَشِيبِي.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'One of the Prophet's supplications was as follows: I seek refuge in You from a wife who causes me to age before my time.

_source.chapter: Obeying One's Wife in Acts of Disobedience to Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِتَّقُوا شرارَ النساءِ وكُونُوا مِن خِيارِهِنَّ عَلى حَذَرٍ ، إن أمَرنَكُم بالمَعروفِ فَخالِفُوهُنَّ كَي لا يَطمَعْنَ مِنكُم في المُنكَرِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Be on your guard against evil women and be wary of even the best of them; if they enjoin you to do good, go against them and do the opposite so that they abandon all hope of your obeying them in doing evil.

_source.chapter: Obeying One's Wife in Acts of Disobedience to Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ امرِئٍ تُدَبِّرُهُ امرَأةٌ فهُو مَلعونٌ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Every man who is controlled by his wife is indeed cursed.

_source.chapter: Things to Be Considered When Spending on One's Family
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن دَخَلَ السُّوقَ فاشتَرى تُحْفةً فَحَمَلَها إلى عِيالِهِ كانَ كَحامِلِ صَدَقَةٍ إلى قَومٍ مَحاوِيجَ ، ولْيَبدَأْ بِالْإناثِ قَبلَ الذُّكُورِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who goes to the market and buys a gift to take back to his family is as one who is taking charity to a group of needy people. He should begin [giving gifts] to the female members of his family before the males.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَنبَغي رِعايَتُهُ في نَفَقَةِ العِيالِ

_source.chapter: Things to Be Considered When Spending on One's Family
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ أرضاكُم عِندَ اللّهِ أسبَغُكُم عَلى عِيالِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, 'Verily the one whom Allah is most pleased with from among you is the one who is the most generous towards his dependents.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَنبَغي رِعايَتُهُ في نَفَقَةِ العِيالِ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Accepting Wedding Invitations
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا دُعِيتُم إلى العُرُساتِ فَأبطِئُوا فإنّها تُذَكِّرُ الدنيا ، وإذا دُعِيتُم إلى الجَنائزِ فَأسرِعُوا فإنّها تُذَكِّرُ الآخِرَةَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'When you are invited to weddings, take your time [in attending] for they incite remembrance of this world's pleasures, and when you are invited to funerals, hasten to attend for they incite remembrance of the Hereafter.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Accepting Wedding Invitations
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا دُعِيَ أحَدُكُم إلى وَلِيمَةِ عُرسٍ فَلْيُجِبْ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'When you are invited to a wedding banquet, do accept.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أعلِنُوا هذا النِّكاحَ واجعَلُوهُ في المَساجِدِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Announce this marriage and let it take place in the mosque.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أظهِرُوا النِّكاحَ وأخفُوا الخِطبَةَ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Publicize the marriage, but conceal the engagement.
